protocol_binding.market_state_rule: For decision session t, use only audited underlying total-return information through the immediately preceding TRADING session. Trailing 126-session total return >=10% is UP, <=-10% is DOWN, otherwise SIDEWAYS. Trailing 21 one-session total-return volatility annualized by sqrt(252) >=30% is HIGH_VOL and may overlap the trend state.

operational_definitions.underlying_total_return: On each TRADING session, gross return=(unadjusted close plus ordinary-share cash entitlement recognized on ex-date)/previous TRADING close. Differential action groups use the Stage8 ordinary/participating-row selection rule. The index is chained from these returns.
operational_definitions.trailing_126_return: TRI[t-1]/TRI[t-127]-1, exactly 126 one-session returns and no information from decision session t.
operational_definitions.trailing_21_volatility: Sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of the 21 one-session total returns ending at t-1, multiplied by sqrt(252).
operational_definitions.trend_episode: A maximal consecutive sequence of classified TRADING sessions with the same UP/DOWN/SIDEWAYS label; non-trading sessions do not create a new episode.
operational_definitions.state_performance: Compound each account's frozen daily returns on sessions carrying the label. Annualized equivalent uses 252/labelled-return-count and is descriptive, not calendar CAGR. Sharpe is sqrt(252)*arithmetic mean daily return/sample standard deviation with zero daily hurdle.
operational_definitions.state_drawdown: Report both the worst full-account drawdown observed on labelled sessions and the worst within-episode drawdown after rebasing each episode to 1. The latter resets at episode boundaries and is not the account's continuous maximum drawdown.
operational_definitions.state_uncertainty: No new confirmatory interval is created. Sparse episode results are case-study attribution and cannot replace the preregistered paired stationary bootstrap.
operational_definitions.anchor_repair: For each P00 ADJACENT_BUY decision, compare decision close, selected PIT DPS, fixed 3.5% anchor Dhat/0.035 and underlying total-return index with the value 63 later TRADING sessions. Insufficient horizon is right-censored; another buy within the horizon marks overlap.
operational_definitions.dividend_reliability: Within the authorized interval report PIT level changes, percentage revisions, effective life and expiries; flag any available downward revision within 180 calendar days after a P00 buy fill without changing the historical signal.
operational_definitions.trade_batch_contribution: Match P00 dynamic buy lots FIFO to later P00 dynamic sells. Batch net contribution equals sale or terminal marked value plus ordinary-share gross cash entitlements while held minus buy cost and allocated buy/sell fees and deferred tax paid. Subtract the largest positive dynamic batch contribution from the frozen P00-vs-RM terminal asset increment while holding all other paths fixed. This is an attribution stress, not a rerun.
operational_definitions.signal_to_fill_adverse_bps: For buys, (fill/decision_close-1)*10000; for sells, (decision_close/fill-1)*10000. Positive means adverse.

decision_constraint: Stage9 may retain or strengthen 修改/观察 but cannot produce 接受 or 淘汰 because the historical pseudo-lock remains unopened, prospective L3 is unavailable, risk matching failed and event sufficiency failed.
